title: ASPIRE: An Agentic System-Identification Platform for Iterative Reasoning and Exploration
description:
arXiv:2611.13114v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: System identification requires expert decisions on the identification method, incorporation of prior physical knowledge, and model validation. We propose ASPIRE, a framework for nonlinear system identification in which a large language model agent selects and executes the identification method.
